intro: Limit profiles cap each bound device separately: download and upload speed, open connections and the times it may use the VPN. A device’s own profile wins over its group’s.
loadError: Failed to load the limit profiles
emptyHint: Create a profile, then bind it to devices or groups.
name: Name
bindingsHint: Saving applies the limits at once. A device bound here uses this profile even if its group has another.
deleteConfirm: Delete limit profile {{name}}? A profile bound to devices or groups cannot be deleted.
perNodeHint: Every device gets these limits on its own; they are not shared.
scheduleNone: No windows: the VPN can be used at any time.
scheduleHint: Outside these windows the device’s VPN traffic is cut off.

errors.speed: Speeds must be positive numbers in Mbit/s (at most 100000), or empty.
errors.connections: Open connections must be a positive whole number, or empty.
errors.noDays: Every window needs at least one day.
errors.quota: The quota must be a positive number of GB (at most 1000000), or empty.
errors.throttle: Slowing down needs a positive speed in Mbit/s.

quotaHint: Download and upload count together, for each device. At 80% a warning is sent; the period starts again on the chosen day at midnight in the profile’s time zone.
